title: Air-quality monitoring
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Gather information about the industry surveyed.
3. Record the date and time of monitoring.
4. Note the specific pollutants measured.
5. Detail the monitoring methods used.
6. Record the concentration levels of each pollutant.
7. Compare collected data with regulatory limits.
8. Identify which pollutants exceed regulatory standards.
9. Provide measurements from multiple monitoring points.
10. Define spatial and temporal characteristics of emissions.
11. Illustrate data through tables, charts, and maps if possible.
12. Explain possible sources or causes of excessive emissions.
13. Comment on meteorological conditions that might influence emissions.
14. Document any observed operational issues or malfunctions.
15. Discuss the compliance status of the industry with respect to emission caps.
16. Include photographic or visual evidence if available.
17. Interview industry representatives or operators if possible.
18. Document efforts (or lack thereof) by the industry to control emissions.
19. Assess possible impacts on human health and the environment
